title: Upholstered furniture manufacturer opening a showroom in San Francisco
assumptions: An upholstered furniture maker opening its own showroom in San Francisco, answering the intake: makes what it sells, doesn't import, doesn't sell online, no children's products. The company, tax, city and building filings are the registry's San Francisco entries, each quoted; beyond them, the plan states what the founder's example listed (formation with the $800 annual LLC tax, EDD within 15 days of $100 in wages, workers' comp with one employee, BHGS's retail license with its fee not confirmed, formula retail only with 11 or more other locations) and, because it manufactures, the law label, TB 117-2013, TSCA Title VI and Prop 65, the last as OEHHA's to decide.
